label: Redaction runs before projection, so every preview, page offset and search index is computed on the text a caller receives.
The shared scrubber is shape-driven, so a generic plant such as FAKE_TOKEN_abc123 or PLANTED_FAKE_TOKEN_9f3a2b1c8d7e6f5a passes through unchanged.
A realistic-looking fake key can still miss: sk-fake- breaks the base62 class and a 33-character AIza tail is under the required 35.
SECRET_ARGUMENT_KEY does not match x-api-key or X-Api-Key, so a header-shaped tool argument leaks both the key and the value.
The array branch of redactArgument drops the key, so an array under a plural secret key is only shape-scanned.
Image blocks are returned unchanged by design, so a token visible in a screenshot is not redacted.
The harness cannot express the redaction criterion: live-hop.sh has no token plant and score.cjs has no redaction field.
The redaction test covers seven vendor shapes and two keyed argument names but not header keys, plural keys, arrays or images.
The preview is the first 160 characters of redacted text, so a token past character 160 yields a reply with neither the token nor a marker.
